false_positives.claim: Parameter counts 12.9/5.3/2.7/29.3 are wrong; should be 14.9/6.0/2.5/28.0
false_positives.executor_finding: REJECTED. Instantiating the authors' own RDDetector (encoder+decoder, bottleneck materialised by a forward pass) gives efficientnet_b0+256d = 5.41M, resnet18 = 13.04M, mobilenetv3_small = 2.66M, swin_tiny = 29.25M. At the paper's reporting precision these are exactly 5.3 / 12.9 / 2.7 / 29.3. The ratio 13.04/5.41 = 2.41 also reproduces the printed 2.4x. The reviewer compared against D:/autopaper/fig/arch_efficiency.csv, which is itself the erroneous artefact (see N1).

false_positives.claim: KG-NAS carpet printed 77.7 but raw 0.7764847 rounds to 77.6
false_positives.executor_finding: REJECTED. The paper consistently publishes at 1 dp values obtained by rounding the 2 dp aggregate: 77.6485 -> 77.65 -> 77.7. Applying that same convention to all 11 baseline averages reproduces 10 of 11 printed values exactly. This is a consistent (if unusual) convention, not an error.

false_positives.claim: CFA average printed 89.8 but raw 89.7465 rounds to 89.7
false_positives.executor_finding: REJECTED for the same reason: 89.7465 -> 89.75 -> 89.8 under the paper's two-step convention, and the detailed baseline table prints 89.75. Consistent.
REJECTED. Same root as F3: the measured encoder+decoder total for EfficientNet-B0+256d is 5.41M, so 5.3 is right.
